Container.Name: MastARR
Container.Overview:
MastARR is a modern web interface for searching and managing your media library with Radarr (movies), Sonarr (TV shows), and SABnzbd (downloads).
Features:
- Dual Search: Search both Radarr (movies) and Sonarr (TV shows) simultaneously
- Fallback URLs: Configure a Local Network URL and a Tailscale IP URL per service — the app tries local first and falls back to Tailscale automatically
- SABnzbd Integration: View download progress and history with statistics
- Calendar View: See upcoming episodes and movie releases
- Modern UI: Clean, responsive interface with multiple themes
- Settings Management: Configure URLs and API keys through a built-in settings page
Configuration: All settings (API keys, URLs) are saved in your browser's localStorage — nothing is stored server-side.
